brief:
Settlers stormed the village of al-Nuzla al-Sharqiya north of Tulkarm overnight, Shehab Wire reported. The incursion occurred in the northern West Bank region, where such raids have become recurring incidents targeting Palestinian communities.

Details of the raid, including the number of settlers involved and the extent of any damage or confrontations, were not immediately available. The village has faced previous settler activity in recent months as tensions persist in the area.
